hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$FILE" ] && exit 0; BASE=$(basename "$FILE"); case "$BASE" in .env|.env.*) case "$BASE" in *.example|*.sample) exit 0 ;; *) echo "Access to env files is denied (only .env*.example or .env*.sample permitted)" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path | select(endswith(".js") or endswith(".ts") or endswith(".jsx") or endswith(".tsx") or endswith(".md"))'); if [ -n "$FILE" ]; then d=$(dirname "$FILE"); while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$d/yarn.lock" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if [ -f "$d/yarn.lock" ]; then (cd "$d" && yarn exec prettier --write "$FILE"); fi; fi
